definitions.gloss: new business venture; new enterprise; new project
definitions.explanation: A newly launched business, project, or line of work within an existing company or as a startup. Common in corporate and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}を{立|た}ち{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: To launch a new business venture.

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}から{新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}に{参入|さんにゅう}する{計画|けいかく}だ。
examples.english: We plan to enter a new business venture starting next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}は{新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}の{開発|かいはつ}に{多額|たがく}の{投資|とうし}を{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: The president decided to invest a large sum in developing a new business venture.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard business term frequently seen in corporate strategy, news articles, and job postings. Often contrasted with {既存|きそん}{事業|じぎょう} (existing business).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}を{立|た}ち{上|あ}げる (to launch a new venture)
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}{開発|かいはつ} (new business development)
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}{部|ぶ} (new business division)
- {新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}に{参入|さんにゅう}する (to enter a new business area)
